comparison.objective: Remove one bottle from a crowded row and place it in a tray; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Clearance-sensitive grasp and transport without toppling adjacent fragile objects, versus fine fastener/collar manipulation and test-fixture operation.
comparison.success_condition: Red bottle must be upright in the tray without another bottle exceeding the tilt/displacement limits; candidate requires two safe repeatable impact stops.
comparison.reason: Crowded-object extraction is unrelated to tuning and locking a passive shock absorber.
